summary: Frontend-only verification of the new '2022-style stagflation' one-click preset on the Monte Carlo tab. All 6 acceptance criteria pass end-to-end on the public preview URL.

test_evidence.card_placement: mc-stagflation-card sits between mc-trials (top≈322px) and mc-shock-toggle (top≈561px) — order verified by getBoundingClientRect.

after_preset_click.toast: '2022-style stagflation preset applied · 2-yr −15% return shock · 5.5% ±3% inflation · stock/bond diversification failure (+0.60).'

test_evidence.run_with_preset: Results rendered in ~15s. mc-stagflation-banner visible above results with correct 2022-style stress copy. mc-corr-result header is 'Correlated Draws (incl. inflation)'. mc-corr-res-stocks_bonds row shows '0.60 · realized 0.59' (requested 0.60 matches preset).
test_evidence.derived_state_honesty: Manually editing mc-corr-stocks_bonds from 0.6 → 0.3 removes ACTIVE badge and button reverts to '2022-style stagflation'. Verified.
test_evidence.clear_preset: Re-applying then clicking again fires 'Stagflation preset cleared' toast; all three toggles return to unchecked; mc-corr defaults restored (stocks_bonds=0.15 confirmed).
test_evidence.regression_plain_run: With no preset (all toggles off), simulation completes and renders mc-gauge-card, mc-compare-card, mc-fan-card, mc-seq-card, mc-hist-card. mc-stagflation-banner, mc-shock-card, mc-inflation-result, mc-corr-result are all absent as expected.

critical_code_review_comments: Derived stagApplied at MonteCarlo.jsx:99 uses strict === on floats (e.g. inflMean === 0.055). Works today because the preset writes those exact literals, but any future refactor that routes preset values through a percent<->decimal round-trip (like the current onChange parsers) could introduce sub-epsilon drift and silently drop the ACTIVE badge. Consider a small tolerance (Math.abs(a-b) < 1e-9) for robustness.

Minor: shockOn=true with corrOn=true but inflOn=false is a valid partial-preset state, yet toggling only inflation off from an ACTIVE preset leaves the shock/corr values that the user probably wants preserved — current clear() resets everything. Acceptable per spec but worth documenting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 22 verified the stagflation preset feature 100% on public preview. Selectors used: mc-stagflation-card, mc-stagflation-preset, mc-stagflation-active, mc-stagflation-banner, mc-shock-toggle, mc-inflation-toggle, mc-corr-toggle, mc-shock-rate/years, mc-inflation-mean/vol, mc-corr-<pair>, mc-corr-res-<pair>, mc-run, mc-gauge-card, mc-fan-card, mc-seq-card, mc-hist-card, mc-compare-card. Monte Carlo backend job completes in ~10-20s. slowapi rate limit tolerated 3 runs comfortably.
rca of the issue: No issue found — feature ships as specified.
